name: Cartoon Characters
description: A recurring cast of rigged 2D cartoon characters who act out your story — talking with lip-sync, waving, pointing, reacting and celebrating in illustrated parallax worlds, with speech bubbles, emotion marks, props and a moving camera. Like a modern animated explainer channel.
fonts: "Baloo 2", "Fredoka", "Nunito", "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", Inter, "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
